 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Sacramento Kings (1-13) and Los Angeles Lakers (13-3) will square off in the NBA Cup tonight. Tipoff is set for 10:00 p.m. ET from Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California. The game will broadcast live on Spectrum SportsNet.
 The Lakers are 14.5-point favorites over the Kings on the spread, with the over/under set at 229.5 total points. The Lakers are -900 moneyline favorites to win outright, while the Kings are listed as +610 underdogs to pull off the upset.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's get into my Kings vs. Lakers predictions and NBA picks for Friday, November 20.
 Kings vs Lakers Prediction
 Kings vs Lakers picks: Lakers -14.5 (-110) | Luka Doncic Over 36.5 Points (-104) 
 My Kings vs Lakers best bets are Los Angeles to cover the spread and Luka Doncic to score 37+ points. Make sure to find the best odds by checking our live NBA odds page.

 Kings vs Lakers Odds
 Kings vs Lakers spread: Lakers -14.5 (-110), Kings +14.5 (-110)
 Kings vs Lakers over/under: 229.5 (-112o / -108u)
 Kings vs Lakers moneyline: Kings +610, Lakers -900
 Kings vs Lakers NBA Cup Preview
 This spread is a lot of points, but this is the NBA Cup, and point differential matters.
 It's also the Kings . It's also the Lakers , and it's Luka Doncic , who loves to run up the score on bad teams.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement I project this line at Lakers -17.9.
 The Kings' average margin of defeat as road underdogs this year is 16 points. They have lost by more than this on average against other teams, and the Lakers' offense is uniquely built to demolish this kind of team.
 I cannot find a single tactical advantage the Kings bring to the table.
 Pick: Lakers -14.5 (-110) 
 Kings vs Lakers Player Prop Pick, Analysis
 Speaking of Luka Doncic, I like him to go over 36.5 points, which is a preposterous line, but I also have him projected at 41.5.
 Luka scored 40 points on November 4 against this same Kings team.
 Sacramento is the second-worst defensive team in the league against both isolation and pick-and-roll ball handlers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Brace yourself for a big game from Doncic tonight.
 Pick: Luka Doncic Over 36.5 Points (-104)
